output.question: What are Alphabet's latest earnings results?
output.answer: Alphabet’s latest results are for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, released October 28, 2026. Revenue rose 25% year over year to $127.6 billion, while net income available to common stockholders fell to $26.2 billion and diluted EPS declined to $2.12 from $2.87. Operating income increased 30% to $40.6 billion, with a 31.8% operating margin. Google Cloud revenue grew 103% to $30.7 billion, while Google Services revenue increased 11% to $96.3 billion. Management attributed the earnings decline primarily to unrealized investment losses; quarterly capital expenditures reached $51.4 billion and free cash flow was negative $9.1 billion.
